title: Huygens's Principle
description: A construction for advancing a wavefront: each point on the current front launches secondary wavelets, and their forward envelope gives the next front. It helps visualize reflection, refraction and spreading at an aperture.

relations.note: Advancing wavefronts at a reflecting boundary recovers equal ray angles.
Wavefront geometry with two propagation speeds yields the refraction law.
Secondary contributions across an aperture provide the introductory wave picture.
